text: Felix confirmed for Saturday. He wants to do the Naschmarkt walk — should we ask Gloria to join? She's been asking to see him.
Good idea. I'll text her. Does he need picking up from Westbahnhof or is he taking the U6?
U6 directly, arrives 14:20. I'll be back from the Kunstmuseum by 13h — Klimt catalogue proofs in the morning but should be done by noon.
Perfect. I'll get something from Türkis for lunch. Catalina coming too or just Felix?
Just Felix this time. Catalina's in Zürich until the 22nd.
